introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: Shinano Labs (“we,” “our,” or “us”) respects your privacy. This policy explains how we handle personal data when you use our websites, apps (including Meanwhile and Myriad Worlds), or contact us.

dataWeCollect.title: Information we collect
dataWeCollect.body:
We may collect information you choose to give us—such as your name, email address, or message content—when you contact support or join a beta list.

We may also collect limited technical data (device type, OS, approximate location derived from IP) to keep our services reliable and secure.

howWeUse.title: How we use information
howWeUse.body: We use personal data to respond to you, improve our products, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell your personal information. Aggregated, non-identifying data may be used for analytics.

yourRights.title: Your rights & children
yourRights.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us. Our services are not directed at children under 13 (US) or 15 (Japan) without parental consent. If you believe a child has provided data without consent, please contact us.

agreement.title: Agreement
agreement.body: By using Shinano Labs websites, apps, or related services (“Services”), you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Services.

services.title: Services
services.body: We provide creative software and related digital services. We may update, suspend, or discontinue features at any time. Some Services may require an account; you are responsible for accurate information and keeping credentials secure.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: Our Services and original content are owned by Shinano Labs unless otherwise noted. Some app content (for example in Myriad Worlds) may be offered under Creative Commons—see that product’s terms. You retain rights to content you create; you grant us a limited license to operate and improve the Services.

liability.title: Liability & termination
liability.body: Services are provided “as is.” To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages. We may suspend or terminate access if these Terms are breached. Individual apps may have additional terms.

governingLaw.title: Governing law
governingLaw.body: These Terms are governed by applicable laws of Japan and the United States. We may update these Terms; material changes will be posted with an updated date.
